text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Curren. I'm coming back late<n>today, just so
you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for your birthday party, Ayabe? I<n>wanna come! I
can make a cake,<n>and—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No, don't bother. There's no party.<n>I'm just going
out to do some<n>stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's a special day for me and my<n>family... The stars
out tonight can only<n>be seen once a year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... Okay, then I'll make some<n>hot cocoa for
you to take. ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I told you. I don't need anything.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. ♪ It gets chilly on these<n>cool spring
nights! I'm sure your<n>family wouldn't want you to
catch a<n>cold celebrating, and...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: A certain star would be worried aboutyou too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I'll make it special and add<n>in some extra
love for your birthday. ♪
